derivation: Hand-derived from RULINGS Q8a (exact total; integer-overflow only when the final result leaves int64), Q8b as revised (AVG over int64 is a typed preflight error without an explicit conversion; with one, binary64 of the exact sum divided by the count, rounded once), docs/datalog.md aggregation rules and testkit O-TESTKIT. Exact rationals and their binary64 rounding were computed with Python Fraction/float (correctly rounded); no Triplex, KV, engine or oracle was run.

fixtureTemplate.command: one command C1 (instant 100) asserting each listed value on its own entity s:<k> (k = 1..n), attribute ':s/v', no entityType, validFrom 0; grouped cases also assert ':s/g' text on the same entity
fixtureTemplate.why-distinct-entities: keeps every input row distinct as a binding, so the cases do not depend on AMB-09 (same-entity equal-valued duplicates)

surfaces.call: Triples.queryAll({ find: ['?total'], where: [['?e', ':s/v', '?v']], aggregate: [['sum', '?v', '?total']] }, { basis: { validAt: 10 } })
the lane's supported aggregate helper fragment over the facts relation (SUM of the int64 exact channel)
raw XTDB SQL SUM over BIGINT and raw SPARQL SUM beyond +/-2^59 are KNOWN-LIMIT cells under Q1; these vectors do not apply to them

valueNotation: $int64:<decimal> = that exact int64 in the surface's declared exact representation (AMB-10)

vectors.title: SUM [2^62, 2^62] overflows
vectors.note: exact total 2^63 is outside [-2^63, 2^63-1]; a wrapping engine returns -9223372036854775808

vectors.title: SUM [2^62, 2^62, -2^62] is exact in every row order
vectors.note: evaluation order must not matter; a left-to-right checked int64 sum would raise on the first partial sum 2^63

vectors.title: Grouped SUM: one group overflowing fails the whole query
vectors.query: Triples.queryAll({ find: ['?g', '?total'], where: [['?e', ':s/g', '?g'], ['?e', ':s/v', '?v']], aggregate: [['sum', '?v', '?total']] }, { basis: { validAt: 10 } })
citations: ACC-6.2 (a success with partial rows always fails)

vectors.title: Empty inputs: ungrouped SUM is one null row, ungrouped COUNT is 0, grouped SUM has no rows
citations: DOCS-DATALOG-AGG (ungrouped empty input returns one row with count zero and the other aggregates null; grouped empty input returns no rows)

vectors.title: AVG over int64 without an explicit conversion is a typed preflight error

expectedError.tagGrounding: derived: docs/datalog.md says unsupported programs fail with typed DatalogValidationError during preflight; Q8b says typed preflight error

vectors.title: AVG over int64 with an explicit binary64 conversion: exact sum / count, rounded once
vectors.conversionSyntax: AMBIGUOUS (AMB-11): no public document names the explicit conversion form

cases.note: converting each input to binary64 first gives (2^53 + 2^53 + (2^53+2)) rounded = 3*2^53, / 3 = 9007199254740992.0 (bits 4340000000000000)
the exact total 2^63 is outside int64 but the final result is a binary64 in range, so no integer-overflow (Q8a applies to the final result)
